messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My hair was pulled up on my head, but part of it fell out onto the back of my neck.

output.original_text: My hair was pulled up on my head, but part of it fell out onto the back of my neck.
output.joy: I had my hair pulled up on my head, and it felt great, but a piece playfully fell down onto the back of my neck!
output.sadness: I had my hair pulled up on my head, but sadly, a part of it fell down onto the back of my neck.
output.fear: I had my hair pulled up on my head, but suddenly part of it slipped down onto the back of my neck, making me feel anxious.
output.anger: I had my hair pulled up on my head, but part of it annoyingly fell out onto the back of my neck.
output.surprise: I had my hair pulled up on my head, and to my surprise, part of it fell onto the back of my neck!
output.disgust: I had my hair pulled up on my head, but part of it grossly fell down onto the back of my neck.
